title: Internal: handling procedure for posting a pending automatic reload
content:
## Applicable situation
This entry covers posting an automatic reload onto a Pro Shop Store Credit account for a tier that offers automatic reload, once the representative has determined whether a reload is currently due and for how much.

## How it is invoked
Posting the reload is carried out through an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): process_pending_auto_reload_c7cf4c5c. The representative determines the amount to post, including passing zero when none is currently due, before making this call.

## Parameters
- credit_account_id: the store-credit account's own reference number, reachable by looking up the member's store-credit account before the call.
- reload_amount: the dollar amount to add to the account's spendable balance for this automatic reload, in USD, with exactly two decimal places, already rounded to the cent; the representative passes 0.00 when no reload is currently due.

## Return
A successful call returns a confirmation naming the new transaction's own reference number and the exact dollar amount added; a call made with zero still logs the check but leaves the balance unchanged.
